question: Why is my postpaid bill higher than my plan rental this month?
answer:
### Short Answer

Charges above your base rental typically come from one or more of: pro-rated charges for a mid-cycle plan change, roaming usage, premium/IVR services, GST, or usage beyond your plan's fair-usage allowance. A full itemised breakdown is available under Billing > View Bill Details in the app.

### Detailed Explanation

A bill above the base rental is essentially the sum of several possible add-ons — none of them mean an error occurred. The itemised breakdown exists precisely so a customer doesn't have to guess which of the five listed causes applied to their specific bill.

### Key Details

| Detail | Value |
|---|---|
| Possible causes | Pro-rated mid-cycle plan change; roaming usage; premium/IVR services; GST; usage beyond fair-usage allowance |
| Where to see the breakdown | Billing > View Bill Details |

### Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Possible Cause | Recommended Action |
|---|---|---|
| Bill higher, changed plan mid-cycle | Pro-rated charge for the plan change | Check the itemised breakdown for a pro-ration line |
| Bill higher, travelled recently | Roaming usage charges | Check the breakdown for roaming line items |
| Bill higher, no plan change or travel | Premium/IVR services, GST, or fair-usage overage | Review the full itemised breakdown to identify which applies |

### Example Scenario

**Customer situation:** A customer changed plans partway through the billing cycle and the bill came in higher than the new plan's rental.

**What happens:** The itemised breakdown under Billing > View Bill Details shows the pro-rated charge for the plan change as a separate line, explaining the difference.
